facts.sneaking: A man in a red hat tiptoes along on the sly, hugging five swords to his chest.
facts.looking-back: He turns his head to look behind him with a faint smile.
facts.two-left: Two swords remain stuck in the ground behind him.
facts.camp: On the right is an encampment of colorful tents.
facts.distant-figures: At the far left, a few people and something like smoke can be seen.

glosses.two-left: What could not all be taken; a trace left behind.
glosses.looking-back: A heart checking whether it will be caught.

reversedGloss.waning: Putting down the plan that was hidden and bringing it into the open.
reversedGloss.internalized: Seems fine outside, but feels pricked inside.

misdescriptions.wrong: He is carrying all seven swords away.
He is bleeding from a cut by the blades.
